scope: Chapter IV practice GROUP C only
audit_method: Every Group C item was independently re-solved; Groups A and B were not re-audited.
All circuit, meter, graph and apparatus figures used for conclusions were inspected directly from repository crops and/or rendered source PDF pages; no wire topology was inferred from OCR.
Power/energy relations were checked with their physical scope: P=UI for the element port variables, P=I^2R and P=U^2/R for resistive elements, and Joule loss I^2r for internal resistance.
Hard circuit solutions were checked in the order equivalent topology -> current/voltage relations -> equations -> solve -> consistency check -> conclusion.
True/False items were checked statement by statement, including meter polarity and current direction.
If a source answer/options conflict with an independently determined result, learner-facing content is minimally repaired while provenance stays only in this internal report.
